correctness.rationale: Independent block sign flips and uniqueness force John and Loewner quadratic forms to be block diagonal. For John containment the exact scalar problem is max_{sum r_i^2<=1}sum_i(a_i r_i)^p<=1; p<2 gives sum a_i^{2p/(2-p)}<=1 and strict weighted AM-GM optimum a_i=w_i^{1/p-1/2}; p>=2 has a_i=1. Loewner containment is max_{sum s_i^p<=1}sum_i(c_i s_i)^2<=1; p<=2 gives max c_i<=1, while p>2 yields sum c_i^{2p/(p-2)}<=1, including p=infty exponent 2, leading w_i^{1/p-1/2} L_i block radii. Equality in Holder identifies all multi-block vs single-block John and Loewner contacts, and arbitrary unit Euclidean radius allocations at p=2. Cancelling common ellipsoid-volume constants yields exp[N H(w)|1/p-1/2|], strictly minimized at p=2. Independently recomputed entropy identity for dimensions (1,2),(3,2,1),(1,3,5) across p=1,1.25,1.8,2,2.5,4,infinity. Source code was read; finite norm samples are corroboration only.
